hook: Hang lanterns on your front row and watch the enemy's biggest units smash their own board.
loop: Place Lantern carriers where enemy attacks will land, mostly the front row.
Each misled attack hits their own side, building Lost and drowns.
Lost, drowns and misleads pay out gold, discounts and permanent stats.

growth.line: Thin mid-game trickle from Joan and Lost; Tier 5–6 payoffs grow permanently per misled attack.

feel.early: Early misleads trade enemy units into each other.
feel.mid: Placement puzzle; stats climb slowly while Lanterns stack.
feel.late: Their carry kills their other carry; big payouts.

stars.why: Misled enemies hit their biggest unit: the tribe's fantasy in one rule.
Doubles both sides of every misled hit; enemy Cleave becomes a wipe.
Hands you half of every enemy that drowns on its own side.

card_short.u02: Grows permanently each time an enemy is led astray.
card_short.u03: Start of Combat: lights the units beside it.
card_short.u04: When your unit dies, relights the nearest unit.
card_short.u05: Start of Turn: gold from Lost.
card_short.u06: Swaps Attack and Health; your side can't be led astray.
card_short.u07: Spends 2 leftover gold for a Turnip Lantern each turn.
card_short.u08: Passes the mislead on: the hit unit goes astray next.
card_short.u09: End of Turn: your Lantern carriers grow permanently.
card_short.u10: Never attacks; Lost discounts Tier up, later gives free Refreshes.
card_short.u11: Swoop; the enemy it hits goes astray next attack.
card_short.u12: Led-astray attacks deal double damage, both ways.
card_short.u13: Start of Turn: top Lantern carrier grows per Lost.
card_short.u14: Banks half of each drowned enemy's stats, then shares them.
card_short.u15: When an enemy kills your unit, that enemy goes astray.
card_short.u16: Lantern 1; drowned enemies lose When-dies effects and Belly.
card_short.u17: Lights your front row; misled enemies hit their biggest unit.
card_short.u18: Fills empty slots with 0/1 Lantern Stepping Stones each fight.
card_short.u19: Every misled enemy gives your other units +1/+1 permanently.
card_short.x01: Item: gives any unit a permanent Lantern.
card_short.x02: 0/1 decoy with Lantern 1; gone after the fight.

builds.name: Lamp Row
builds.line: Stack permanent Lanterns on the front row with Jack, Joan, Steward.

builds.name: Drowning
builds.line: Reflection, Follette and Old Will make their carry kill their carry.

builds.name: Stepping Stones
builds.line: Leave gaps; Causeway Stones mislead, die, and feed Foxfire and Tiddy Mun.

liked: All three: Old Will plus Reflection makes their carry double into their other carry.
Borrowed damage: it gets stronger as the lobby does; no tribe works like it.
worries: Watch: Stingy Jack's Turnips can lock out the enemy; Causeway Stones' timing unsettled.
Watch: uncapped Ignis Fatuus, Steward and Hoard Mere could grow far past targets.
changed: A misled attack with nobody else to hit now hits itself, ending stalls.
Lost counts every misled attack and isn't spent; Reflection doubles both ways.
Stingy Jack now costs 2 gold per Turnip; Spunkie gives Refreshes at Tier 6.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct; ranked first of its seed's three; for players who like turning the enemy's strength against it.
